subject: Twelve Olympians
prompt: Eleven of the twelve Olympian gods are agreed on. The last seat is disputed between Hestia and whom?
why: Ancient sources disagree over whether the twelfth Olympian is Hestia, goddess of the hearth, or Dionysus. Hades is never counted -- he rules the underworld, not Mount Olympus.

subject: Pound sterling
prompt: Sterling holds which distinction among the world's currencies?
why: Sterling has been in continuous use since its inception, longer than any other currency. It is only the fourth-most-traded on the foreign exchange market.

subject: 2023 Turkey–Syria earthquakes
prompt: Hours after a magnitude 7.8 quake devastated southern Turkey and northern Syria in February 2023, what happened?
why: The second shock struck the same day, centred 95 km north-northwest of the first. Two near-identical quakes in one day is why the damage was so widespread.

subject: Scientology
prompt: Scientology grew out of a system L. Ron Hubbard first presented in 1950 as a form of talk therapy. What was it called?
why: Hubbard published Dianetics in 1950 as therapy, then reframed it as a religion and founded the Church of Scientology in 1953.

subject: Grand Slam (tennis)
prompt: In tennis, a true Grand Slam means winning all four majors within what span?
why: All four in one calendar year is the Grand Slam proper. Four in a row across two years is a non-calendar-year Grand Slam, and four at any point is a Career Grand Slam -- three different achievements.

subject: Ayahuasca
prompt: The Quechua name ayahuasca translates roughly as what?
why: It means 'spirit rope' or 'liana of the soul' -- a liana being a woody vine. The name refers both to the Banisteriopsis caapi vine and to the brew made from it.

subject: 4chan
prompt: What can users not do on 4chan, unlike almost every other major forum?
why: Registration is unavailable to anyone but staff, so users post anonymously by default. That design is the root of both the site's culture and its reputation.

subject: Starlink
prompt: Starlink needs thousands of satellites rather than a handful because they fly in which kind of orbit?
why: A low orbit means each satellite covers a small patch of ground and moves fast overhead, so continuous coverage takes a constellation of thousands rather than a few high satellites.

subject: Spirited Away
prompt: Which studio animated Hayao Miyazaki's 2001 fantasy film Spirited Away?
why: Ghibli produced it under Toshio Suzuki, and Toho distributed it. It follows Chihiro, a girl trapped in a world of Shinto spirits.

subject: Age of Enlightenment
prompt: The Age of Reason emerged in the late 1600s but reached its peak in which century?
why: Enlightenment ideas spread across Europe and the colonies through the 1700s, promoting reason, empirical evidence and individual liberty.
